sn45.146-148:3.2: In the same way, all skillful qualities are rooted in diligence and meet at diligence,
sn45.146-148:3.3: and diligence is said to be the best of them.
sn45.146-148:3.4: A mendicant who is diligent can expect to develop and cultivate the noble eightfold path.
sn45.146-148:3.5: And how does a mendicant who is diligent develop and cultivate the noble eightfold path?
sn45.146-148:3.6: It’s when a mendicant develops right view, which relies on seclusion, fading away, and cessation, and ripens as letting go … develops right concentration, which relies on seclusion, fading away, and cessation, and ripens as letting go …
sn45.146-148:3.7: That’s how a mendicant who is diligent develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path.”
